pin_regs.reason: Every port is a flop D/Q in RTL (L2H-BW SAFE face): K pure capture (k_v 22 pure region D pins, kp_* captures), k_rdy=k_rdy_q, KR skid head flops on the native RL1 ABI, kr_rdy 18 pure region D pins, OREG PHY output flops, RREG PHY return capture, registered pc_fault; tool wrappers would add a second stage and break the RL1 contract.

reroute_reason.why: new master kit (MC3b: wr_ok copies + 256-leaf reset forest after the MC3 native census); hdie_pc_ctrl_mc3_p540/q648 gated WARN but never routed

reset_landing.reason: RTL top g_reset_face.rst_l0/rst_l1 are two kept same-clock registered face landing stages; ot_rst_forest adds 3 (s0, l1, l2); release 5 edges (production bench native_reset_release_edges=5). Tool landing would add a duplicate pair.
